mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APV_LINE (submission_id, step_order, approver_id, approver_nm) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{stepOrder}, #{approverId}, #{approverNm})
mapper.select: SELECT line_id, submission_id, step_order, approver_id, approver_nm, status, comment_cn, processed_at FROM APV_LINE WHERE submission_id = #{value} ORDER BY step_order

SELECT l.line_id AS line_id, l.submission_id AS submission_id, l.step_order AS step_order, s.title AS title, s.template_nm AS template_nm, s.requester_nm AS requester_nm, s.submitted_at AS submitted_at FROM APV_LINE l JOIN APV_SUBMISSION s ON s.submission_id = l.submission_id WHERE l.approver_id = #{value} AND l.status = '대기' AND s.status = '진행중' AND s.current_step_order = l.step_order ORDER BY s.submitted_at
mapper.update: UPDATE APV_LINE SET status = #{status}, comment_cn = #{commentCn}, processed_at = NOW() WHERE line_id = #{lineId} AND approver_id = #{approverId} AND status = '대기'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(step_order), 0) FROM APV_LINE WHERE submission_id = #{value}
